question: Does the existing rule-only full-type static material candidate improve finite game utility over Unit on fresh generated 5x5 rules at a fixed paid budget, when the censor horizon is 96 candidate plies as specified?
changed_premise: The retained first panel had an implementation deviation: its producer stopped after 96 total plies (48 candidate plies), although its plan specified 96 candidate plies. Do not extend/refill that frozen panel. This separate validation uses never-used rule seeds and implements the original candidate-relative horizon.

rules.selection: All eight deterministic generated rules and every prespecified prefix are retained; no outcome- or feature-based filtering. Seeds are distinct from the retained 521001-521008 panel. No AUX rules/files or training outputs are reused.

roots.terminal_prefixes: Retain as zero-search terminal slots; do not replace.

arms.color_swap: Both candidate colors on each identical root/opponent pair. Candidate and foe checkpoints are fixed before any games.

outcomes.horizon: Stop only after the candidate has completed 96 legal candidate moves, unless an actual Core terminal occurs first. An ongoing game at that boundary is UNKNOWN; preserve it in finite bounds as [-1,1]. Do not convert to draw or extend the horizon.
outcomes.actual_terminal: Score the actual Core Session result, including actual repetition or rule max-ply terminal outcomes.
outcomes.contrast: Within each fixed-foe/root/color-swapped pair, static_v2 candidate score minus Unit candidate score; report each foe separately, all seed-family values, finite bounds, UNKNOWN counts and actual nodes/caller time.
outcomes.decision: Strictly positive finite bounds against both foes retain static_v2 as a 5x5 candidate only. Nonpositive upper bounds against both de-prioritize it for this sampled 5x5 regime. Otherwise unresolved. No default, global price, training, population or strength claim.

cost.expected: 128 games with up to twice the first panel's total-ply horizon; the first panel spent 93 seconds for 48 candidate plies at most, suggesting under 4 minutes plus setup/replay. Budgeted below 40 minutes.
cost.cheaper_alternative: The retained 48-candidate-ply panel provides a conditional shorter-horizon sensitivity only and cannot answer the registered 96-candidate-ply question. Profile-only calculations cannot answer game utility.

integrity: No training, solver, new worker, AUX checkout write or old panel refill.
Preserve promotion, drop, full Session history, repetition and real terminal results.
No seed replacement or outcome imputation; the prior panel remains separately reported as protocol-deviant.
